title: NASA CEA reference runs (reference-code outputs, not measurements)
code: NASA CEA via the official NASA Python package cea 3.3.4 (PyPI, Apache-2.0, NASA Glenn; re-implementation of Gordon & McBride NASA RP-1311), validated here against the CEA2 Fortran 2004 output of RP-1311 Example 8 shipped as NASA_CEA_Fortran/cea2.out in the rocketcea 1.2.3 sdist
settings: rocket, infinite-area combustor, products from thermo.lib; H2(L) 20.27 K, O2(L) 90.17 K, RP-1 298.15 K; 'frozen' = composition frozen at the throat

acceptance.inputs: llull nozzle_performance is given the CEA chamber temperature, chamber gamma and chamber molar mass (one constant gamma for the whole expansion)
acceptance.note: c* depends only on the chamber state and matches to 0.02 %. A constant low (chamber) gamma reproduces CEA's shifting-equilibrium Isp to about +1.3..+2.7 %; CEA's frozen-at-throat Isp is 4-6 % lower because the frozen gamma rises from 1.15 to 1.26-1.28 along the nozzle, which a one-gamma model cannot represent. Frozen values are kept for reference, not as a gate.
